Original mod by Laast https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2523248314 If the original author requests it, I will remove this update.
--
Added textures for Odyssey biomes.
Did not fully test all compatible biomes listed, please let me know if anything is off.
--
Original mod notes (1.3):
World Map Enhanced replaces the bland vanilla world ground textures with custom ones more detailed and more pretty.
Now you'll enjoy preparing your next trip on the map!
Compatibility:
Completes World Map Beautification Project very well.
It is not technically required but it's strongly recommended as World Map Enhanced has been created with it in mind and modifies existing content from this mod (mainly mountains colors to match the vanilla biomes ground. Snow capped mountains will also appear only when the average temperature is below zero).
Although I've made WMBP as a required file when you subscribe to this mod, you can use World Map Enhanced without it (but seriously why would you do that?) [I have not made it a dependency for this continued version]
Always load World Map Enhanced after WMBP (You can load it before WMBP if you don't want its content to be recolored).
Fully supports ground textures for: - Alpha Biomes - More Vanilla Biomes - Advanced Biomes (Continued) - ReGrowth 2 - MorrowRim - Realistic Planets 1.6 - [RF] Permafrost (Continued) - Edo Themed Expansion
World Map Enhanced does not modify nor add mountains and trees to these biome mods. You need to get corresponding patches for WMBP.
Always load World Map Enhanced after any biomes mod.
